name: cover-bg-a
prompt: Turn the attached film frame into the background picture for a 16:9 movie cover. Keep its composition exactly: seen straight down from high above, a vast dark creature fills the black sea, its two enormous glowing green eyes on the right, and a tiny glowing golden speck (a small manta with riders) at the centre. Make it polished cinematic key art: deep true blacks, rain texture on the water, a faint cold rim of light tracing the creature's outline so its immense shape reads, the tiny golden light the brightest point in the frame. Leave the top quarter of the picture as calm dark water with nothing in it, for a title to go there later. No text, no letters, no title, no logo, no watermark, no border, no frame. Landscape 16:9.
